claims.statement: Qualified dividends are subject to the same 0%, 15%, or 20% maximum rate as net capital gain.
Common stock must be held more than 60 days during the 121-day period beginning 60 days before the ex-dividend date.
2026 single filer 0% band ends at $49,450 and 15% band at $545,500.
Box 1a includes amounts in box 1b; box 1b is the qualified portion.
